rules: P5 v2 builder must not read these case configurations or P6/P6-v2 measurement outputs.
P6-v3 preflight freezes the P5 v2 SHA and writes all numerical predictions before compilation or measurement.
Every case uses three independent processes and requires compile, correctness, and timing stability before error calculation.
No P6-v3 value can be used to change the P5 v2 model or its declared domain.
